description: Reference implementation accompanying the article “Body composition on contrast-enhanced photon-counting CT: anatomy-guided material decomposition versus threshold segmentation”. The software performs an anatomy-guided three-material decomposition of contrast-enhanced photon-counting CT into adipose tissue, an anatomically selected iodine-free base tissue and iodine, and compares the resulting adipose volumes with threshold-based volumes (−190 to −30 HU) over identical voxels. Imaging data are not included and cannot be shared publicly.
notes: Funded by the Margarete-Ammon-Stiftung (Thannhausen, Germany; project 10_2026, awarded to J.A.D.). Secondary analysis of the Equal-CT trial, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06965790.
